answer: A POAP is minted only after the entry scan confirms the attendee is inside, and the jade of the design is that the mint transaction references the entry scan id. The beacon of the scheme is that the POAP cannot be claimed from home, because the entry scan is the gate. A Sybil cannot farm POAPs remotely, because each mint needs a real scan at the door, and the vertex of the gating means the collectible proves presence, not just a wallet.
